description: Generic 100 Gbit/s pair; ideal line rate, synthetic 2 us latency, fixed compute times.
assumptions: 12.5 GB/s is 100 Gbit/s divided by 8, without protocol overhead.
Two directly connected endpoints; no Ethernet switches, packet overhead, or transport protocol is modeled.
2000 ns link latency and 10-cycle endpoint delay are synthetic assumptions.
Compute and memory reference values are inherited from two_rank; roofline is disabled.
